# Filevora

Navigation index for coding agents. This is not a capability claim. Trust `docs/agents/capabilities.json` and the tests.

- [README](README.md)
- [Library methods](README.md#library-methods) — every feature as a typed in-process method on `createFiles()` from `filevora/server`, with the same validation and error codes as the HTTP route that calls it. `getMany` (batch get), `watchProgress` (the SSE stream as an async iterator), `doctor`, `migrate`, `listPresets`, and `verifyWebhookSignature` for received webhooks. `ctx.policy` narrows upload limits.
- [Install](docs/agents/install.md)
- [Decision guide](docs/agents/decision-guide.md)
- [Troubleshooting](docs/agents/troubleshooting.md)
- [Verification](docs/agents/verification.md)
- [Capabilities](docs/agents/capabilities.json) — versioned manifest of exports, HTTP routes, env vars, error codes, and the progress event. `filevora manifest --json` and `import { readManifest } from 'filevora/manifest'`. `filevora mcp` exposes it over stdio with no extra dependency.
- [Manifest](docs/agents/manifest.md)
- [Init](docs/agents/init.md) — `filevora init --json --dry-run` detects Express, Fastify, Hono, Next.js, or Node and writes handler, client, and env files. It does not overwrite without `--force`.
- [Doctor](docs/agents/doctor.md) — `filevora doctor --json` checks config, mode, storage, Redis, the database, ffmpeg, the scanner, and webhooks. `health: true` on the HTTP handler serves the same report.
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md) — no `FILEVORA_DATABASE_URL` is lite mode; a URL selects stored mode. Schemes: `postgres://`, `postgresql://`, `mysql://`, `mariadb://`, `sqlite://` or a file path. Migrate creates `filevora_assets`, `filevora_asset_versions`, and `filevora_asset_tags`. S3 storage keeps asset bytes and lite `.filevora/` cards in the bucket. `POST /assets/from-url` imports an http(s) URL. The SDK sniffs the bytes and blocks private and metadata addresses.
- Upload safety: optional `FILEVORA_MALWARE_SCAN=clamav` after the original is stored and before encoding. `FILEVORA_EXIF_STRIP=gps` (default) drops location metadata from image versions. `FILEVORA_TYPE_MAX_BYTES` limits size by sniffed type.
- [Testing](docs/agents/testing.md) — `filevora/testing` runs filesystem lite mode with synchronous processing. No Redis or S3.
- [Retention](docs/agents/retention.md) — `FILES_RETENTION_*` and `FILES_UNUSED_RETENTION_DAYS`. Stored mode keeps `last_accessed_at` on the asset row. Lite mode keeps it on the asset card and falls back to creation time. Cleanup also removes old orphans.
- [Webhooks](docs/agents/webhooks.md) — optional signed completion webhooks. The body matches the terminal SSE event. Targets use the URL-import SSRF checks. Localhost needs `FILES_WEBHOOKS_ALLOW_LOOPBACK`.
- [Transform](docs/agents/transform.md) — `POST /files/:assetId/transform` with one config object. `replace` defaults to true. `preset` names a built-in or custom recipe. Progress events share `phase`, `percentage`, `etaMs`, and a terminal `versions` list.
- [Presets](docs/presets.md) and [docs/agents/presets.md](docs/agents/presets.md) — named image, video, audio, and PDF presets. `POST /pdf/merge` and `POST /files/:id/split` create new PDFs. `FILEVORA_PRESETS` or `presets` in config adds custom ones. Default `web-optimized` is unchanged.
- [Direct S3 upload](docs/direct-upload.md) and [docs/agents/direct-upload.md](docs/agents/direct-upload.md) — signed single PUT or multipart. Complete verifies the object and starts processing. `uploadDirect` is the client helper. Bucket CORS must expose `ETag`.
- [Framework helpers](docs/frameworks.md) — `filevora/next`, `filevora/express`, `filevora/fastify`, `filevora/hono`, and optional `filevora/react` hooks (`useUpload`, `useAssetProgress`). No UI components. `filevora/client` stays free of Node builtins.
- [Descriptions](docs/descriptions.md) and [docs/agents/descriptions.md](docs/agents/descriptions.md) — optional Gemini descriptions in stored mode. `FILEVORA_GEMINI_API_KEY`, `FILEVORA_DESCRIBE_ASSETS` (default false), and per-asset `describe`. Content is sent to Google only when a description runs. Lite mode returns `DESCRIPTION_REQUIRES_DATABASE`. Missing key with `describe: true` returns `DESCRIPTION_NOT_CONFIGURED`.
- [Semantic search](docs/search.md) and [docs/agents/search.md](docs/agents/search.md) — `POST /files/search` with a natural-language `query` in any language. Stored mode and `FILEVORA_GEMINI_API_KEY`. Vectors from `gemini-embedding-001` at 768 dimensions are written when a description finishes and live in the host database. `minScore` (default 0.55, uncalibrated), `maxResults` (default 100, cap across pages), `limit`, and `cursor`. Each hit has a `score`. Errors `SEARCH_QUERY_INVALID` and `EMBEDDING_UNAVAILABLE`. MCP tool `search_assets` runs live. No bulk reindex: run describe again after a model change.
- [List filters](docs/list.md) and [docs/agents/list.md](docs/agents/list.md) — `GET /files` only. `type`, dates, tags, `q`, mime, filename, size, duration, dimensions, status, visibility, preset, and sort. Description filters need a database and `FILEVORA_GEMINI_API_KEY`. For search by meaning use `POST /files/search`.
- [Access control](docs/access-control.md) and [docs/agents/access-control.md](docs/agents/access-control.md) — `public` or `private` assets, HMAC delivery URLs, key rotation, and URL revocation.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md)
- [Security](docs/security.md)
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md)
- [Agents](AGENTS.md)
